## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Research / evaluation
- [ ] Data tooling or dataset governance
- [ ] Security

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated where appropriate
- [ ] `pytest` passes
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] No secrets, private data, or unlicensed material added

## Research, data, and safety impact

Describe any effect on model behavior, dataset provenance, privacy, licensing, language coverage, or agricultural safety. Write "None" only after checking.

## Reproducibility

List relevant model IDs/revisions, data release IDs, configuration changes, seeds, and hardware. For documentation-only changes, write "Not applicable."
